title: BADF Decision Governance / Board Authority v0.1 contract freeze
objective: Freeze one non-activating decision-governance contract that separates constitutional authority, evidence, hard rules, risk appetite, calibrated independent council judgment, deterministic aggregation, and execution permission before any Agent Council authority expansion.
business_value: Move BST human attention from routine operational approvals toward constitutional ownership while establishing the controls, evidence and shadow thresholds required before bounded multi-agent board authority can be considered safely.
in_scope: normative Decision Governance / Board Authority v0.1 architecture at DESIGNED / ADVISORY_ONLY
decision-policy, risk-appetite and council-registry machine-readable contracts
ballot, decision-dossier, calibration-ledger, decision-policy, risk-appetite and council-registry schemas
deterministic integer weighted-aggregation semantics and separate risk evaluation
C3A/C3R routing, board-authority evidence, autonomous-merge predicate fixed false in v0.1
historical shadow protocol, activation ladder and contract-drift tests
extend the canonical gate's required/integrity surfaces only; no second validator
reconciliation of the immediately preceding landed Work Package against its exact main commit and tree
out_of_scope: any edit to badf/authority-matrix.json, human-reserved roles or reserved actions
enabling auto-merge, merging this PR, changing GitHub rulesets, deploying a controller or issuing credentials
active council membership or structural identities not already present in badf/seats.json
claiming calibration or decision-quality improvement before historical shadow evidence exists
allowing a chair, builder, model count, confidence or weighted majority to create authority
change_class_rationale: This unit defines future authority-policy semantics and autonomous-merge preconditions. It is C3 even though every v0.1 output is advisory and the current authority matrix remains unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: all named artifacts have one owner, version/epoch, explicit DESIGNED or ADVISORY_ONLY status, and no duplicate authority source
ballot and dossier schemas bind question/options, exact GitHub remote workspace commit/tree identity, policy digests, evidence, member/run identity and expiry
aggregation is integer, reproducible and fully specified; criterion weight and evaluator weight remain separate; self-confidence, price and brand never contribute
hard rules execute before weighting and verified blockers, conditions, stale evidence, missing quorum and C3R are non-compensable
C3A and C3R are disjoint; ambiguity routes to C3R; both remain HUMAN_REQUIRED in v0.1
autonomous_merge.eligible and policy_active are schema-fixed false; BOARD_AUTHORIZED is absent from v0.1 dossier dispositions
shadow protocol controls outcome leakage and measures false-authorize, false-block, missed blocker, quorum inflation, determinism, calibration, evidence cost and latency
ADVERSARIAL: the contract refuses weighted support over a blocker, same-family quorum inflation, stale digests and approval-with-open-conditions
the new policy and schema surfaces are required and integrity-locked through scripts/badf_gate.py; no second gate or decision engine is introduced
completion remains HUMAN_REQUIRED; later IMPLEMENTED, VALIDATED, SHADOWED, RATIFIED and ACTIVE rungs each require a separate work package
permissions: read: bstBizEra/badf repository, issues, PRs and attached Git-flow reference
write: GitHub issue #312 and wp/WP-2026-0137-decision-governance-contract via PR only
evidence: contract cross-file tests and JSON/schema loading
independent governance, security, architecture, quality, operations and evidence-auditor review
WP-2026-0134 reconciled as CLOSED against main commit 310a660259752260142458f1e7f51976b218a79d and landed tree 129183c1bfb9ec494c13893a26addcc465151abc

rollback.method: revert the squash commit through an independently authorized PR; v0.1 creates no external authority or merge effect

note: Contract-freeze rung only. v0.1 cannot emit BOARD_AUTHORIZED, cannot alter current authority, and cannot merge itself.
